DeleteAccount.metaTitle: ลบบัญชี — Five Cut Pro
DeleteAccount.metaDescription: Request deletion/deactivation of your Five Cut Pro account. Requests are accepted immediately; the account is deactivated within 7 days.
DeleteAccount.title: ลบบัญชี
DeleteAccount.intro: Use this form to request deletion of your Five Cut Pro account (App Store / Google Play compliance). Requests are accepted immediately (auto success).
DeleteAccount.point1: Your request is recorded and accepted as soon as it is submitted.
DeleteAccount.point2: Within 7 days the account will be deactivated (sign-in disabled). By default we do not hard-delete data.
DeleteAccount.point3: Email support@fivecutpro.com if this was a mistake or you want to cancel before deactivation.
DeleteAccount.formDesc: Enter the email you used to register / sign in to Five Cut Pro.
DeleteAccount.reasonPlaceholder: Why do you want to delete your account?
DeleteAccount.confirmLabel: I confirm I want to request deletion/deactivation of the Five Cut Pro account for the email above. I understand the request is accepted immediately and the account will be deactivated within 7 days.
DeleteAccount.successTitle: รับคำขอแล้ว
DeleteAccount.successBody: Your request has been accepted. The account will be deactivated within 7 days. By default we do not hard-delete data.
DeleteAccount.errorGeneric: Could not submit. Please try again or email support@fivecutpro.com.
